{{Quote|Da fourth bein' in da Darkwalker cave near Dee'ja Peak.|[[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RaSPotsGA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Recover all Six Pieces of the scattered Gungan Artifact|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Darkwalker Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located a very short distance south of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
{{Quote|Well, I imagine you'll have to attack them at their base. I'd guess that one of their leaders, Flangolial or Trienial, would have it. You'll probably want to soften up their defenses first. Their base is not far from the city, though you probably already know that.|[[Tanoa Vills]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtsBS" />}}
[[File:DarkwalkerCaveDeeja.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Trienial within the depths of the cave]]
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the cave was under the control of a criminal organization known as the [[Darkwalkers]].<ref name="SWG:FowtDtftCS" /> Among the cave's occupants included important Darkwalker members, including [[Bloodlord]] [[Trienial]] and [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief of Science]] [[Flangolial]].<ref name="SWG:RtsBS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Recover the stolen Bio-Scanner|Naboo}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Darkwalkers shot down a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] near Dee'ja Peak in order to steal a [[Bioscan/Legends|bio-scanner]]. The shuttle crashed in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] and the Darkwalkers plundered the wreckage.<ref name="SWG:FowtDtftCS" /> A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working with the scientist [[Tanoa Vills]] then raided the Darkwalker Cave nearby to recover the stolen bio-scanner. Bloodlord Trienial and Chief of Science Flangolial were killed during the assault.<ref name="SWG:RtsBS" /> A few time later, a spacer sent by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] entered the cave to retrieve one of the pieces of a broken [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact scattered by the [[Ultragungans]] in various areas of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:RaSPotsGA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Darkwalker Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FowtDtftCS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Darkwalker Cave was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]],"<ref name="SWG:FowtDtftCS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
